revision_budget.description: Initial generation + up to 2 targeted revisions = max 3 attempts

revision_playbook.description: Targeted remediation deltas; never full rewrite

targets.VISUAL_CLUTTER: Reduce secondary objects; isolate hero subject
targets.MOBILE_UNREADABLE: Increase type scale for small-screen legibility
targets.FABRICATED_CLAIM: Strip unsupported language; keep approved copy

approval_logic.rule: Approve first PASS or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS cycle
approval_logic.fail_closed: Never mark FAIL asset as final_approved_asset

fail_after_budget.test: orchestrator FAILED when all QA attempts fail after revision budget
fail_after_budget.behavior: Return FAILED status with final_approved_asset = null
